scope: local source/real-Chromium reproduction only; NOT hosted acceptance. Hosted Management outcome and aggregate remain FAIL for the exact 82ff run.
root_cause: The continueRequest rejection handler captured closed/detached/canceled booleans before its 25ms wait, so lifecycle events (loadingFailed canceled, new Document request, frameNavigated/detach) queued behind the CDP command rejection were never seen; a genuinely cancelled intercepted request was classified as a live Invalid InterceptionId.
fix: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs: for Invalid InterceptionId only, send Performance.getMetrics in the same tick immediately before Fetch.continueRequest. CDP processes commands in order, so its Chromium Timestamp is a lower bound of the actual command rejection that does not depend on when the rejection is delivered to the process. Then poll (10ms, 1000ms bound) for ordered facts: Network.loadingFailed canceled with Chromium timestamp <= that sample, correlated by network id to the intercepted request and caused by document replacement, Page.navigatedWithinDocument or frame detach. Missing sample = failure. Closure alone is never proof; cancellation/navigation/teardown after the rejection (however late it is delivered) cannot excuse a live invalid id.
